ارتطمن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَطَمْنَ (irtaṭamna) /ir.ta.tˤam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَطَمَ (irtaṭama)
# اِرْتَطِمْنَ (irtaṭimna) /ir.ta.tˤim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَطَمَ (irtaṭama)
